name: Ecosystem penetration
interpretation: Read the number and combination of owned categories; no automatic Luna compatibility inference.
source_description_original: Numero e combinazione delle categorie possedute

name: Cross-category affinity
interpretation: Explore category and interest associations as hypotheses with explicit provenance.
source_description_original: Associazioni tra categorie e interessi per dispositivi connessi

name: Path to purchase
interpretation: Interpret sequences of synthetic visits, configurations, support and contacts before a purchase.
source_description_original: Sequenze di visite, configurazioni, assistenza e contatti prima dell'acquisto

name: Channel affinity
interpretation: Keep discovery channel, conversion channel and stated preference distinct.
source_description_original: Canale di scoperta, conversione e preferenza dichiarata, senza confonderli

name: Value & incrementality
interpretation: Prioritize illustrative value. Incrementality requires a comparison experiment and cannot be inferred from simulated sales.
source_description_original: Valore e priorità; l'incrementalità richiede un confronto sperimentale, non si desume da vendite simulate

name: White-space analysis
interpretation: Record unmet needs and uncovered combinations as testable hypotheses, not proven market opportunities.
source_description_original: Bisogni o combinazioni non coperti, registrati come ipotesi da testare
